description: Objective-C adds objects and messages to C. You may meet it when reading older Apple app code. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.
versionNote: Examples use modern Objective-C with Apple Foundation and ARC on macOS.
whatYouWillLearn: Send a message to an object with Objective-C
Find a value by key with Objective-C
learningObjectives: Build a string with a value with Objective-C
